decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera sits at the core of the firm's optical and star-tracker heritage and still has its own page, so management can interpret mission feedback and keep improving it through in-house R&D.

The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's docking and rendezvous sensor know-how and fits its strategy toward smaller spacecraft, so despite its modest web presence the long qualification cycle argues for continuing it.
The radiation-hard camera line is close to the firm's established imaging competence and has its own page, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and adapt the models.

The asteroid navigation camera extends the firm's proven navigation optics into deep-space missions where its R&D and agency cooperation give it the knowledge to refine the product, so it is too early to judge it a failure.
